newsitem.title: INDIA: Separatist bomb kills six Indian soldiers.
newsitem.headline: Separatist bomb kills six Indian soldiers.

text.p: A bomb planted by separatist guerrillas killed six army soldiers and seriously wounded four in the northeast Indian state of Assam on Tuesday, police said.
They said the bomb that went off around midnight was planted by guerrillas of the United Liberation Front of Asom (ULFA), which is fighting for a separate nation in the tea- and oil-rich province.
ULFA has accused New Delhi of ignoring regional development while exploiting the area's mineral wealth.
